intro.narration: A warehouse at the edge of the barangay. No light but a single bulb over the table. The man who has never lost is already seated.

intro.speaker: the_don
intro.text: Hello. It has been a long time since anyone climbed all the way up here. Sit.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: ...Still you. You never age, old man.

intro.speaker: the_don
intro.text: Carding. Thirty-seven years. I thought you would never come back to this table.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: I'm not the one who came back. My apo did. And this time, I'm on their side.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Wait, wait, THIS is the 1987?! This is the reason for 'unbeaten since 1987'?! A living legend, right in front of me!

intro.speaker: the_don
intro.text: 1987. Carding bet his house against me. He lost. He never played me again, until now.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: You beat me back then. You did not beat my apo.

intro.speaker: the_don
intro.text: Good. At last, a real match. And here, at this table, diamonds are king. The two of diamonds is the crown.

intro.narration: The Don set an old key on the table, the key to the house Lolo lost in 1987.

intro.speaker: the_don
intro.text: Win tonight, and I return the house. Lose, and the legend stands, along with my silence.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: You hear that, apo? Put down the three. Let's finish what we started in '87.

win.narration: Your last card fell. For the first time in three decades, The Don was silent, and beaten.

win.speaker: the_don
win.text: ...Out. Nothing left. Thirty-seven years... and now it is over.

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: HA! Did you see that?! Did you see, old man?! My apo, MY APO!

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: THE DON IS BEATEN! NOBODY HAS WON AGAINST HIM SINCE 1987! I'M BROADCASTING THIS TO THE WHOLE WORLD!

win.speaker: the_don
win.text: Take the key, kid. And the title. I no longer need the silence. You gave me the match I waited so long for.

win.speaker: the_don
win.text: Carding. Thank you for your apo. This is the first time I have lost again... and I am glad.

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: ...Thank you too, my friend. We are both free now.

lose.speaker: the_don
lose.text: Not yet. Like Carding in 1987, close, but not enough.

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Don't be sad, apo. You made it all the way to this table. It took me thirty-seven years to get back here.

lose.speaker: the_don
lose.text: Come back. I will be waiting, I am a patient opponent. Ask Carding.

lines.speaker: the_don
lines.text: I'm down to three. Just like 1987... except back then, I was in your seat.

lines.speaker: the_don
lines.text: Only one left for you. No one ever got this far before, not even Carding.
